text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Elevated 95th+ latency and partial errors observed in smart-routing layer for hosted API storefront. Paging on-call SRE: @jamie.chen. Potential impact to trial/free tiers and regional lanes. Automated mitigation suggestions posted.
jamie.chen: acked. seeing spike in router queue depth and persistent 503s from runtime proxies. --- pulling logs now.
alex.rivera: I can see traffic skewing to us-east1-gpu-pool, queue growth ~3x, and small-model variants overloaded. KV cache miss rate jumped too.
priya.nair: are we seeing model OOMs or just overloaded endpoints? any new deploys?
deploy-bot: deploys: none in last 30m. Canary health ok. No rollback events.
jamie.chen: no new deploys. looks like a traffic shape change from a big customer test + organic spike. impact roughly: higher latency for tier=standard and errors for tier=free when they get routed to overloaded pools.
marc.levine: we're getting 2 customers pinging support about timeouts. priority: stop user-facing errors, keep resp time for paid tiers.
alex.rivera: propose two live mitigations: 1) circuit-breaker to limit tier=free to 150rps and steer to us-west2-small; 2) temporarily disable experimental reranking pipeline to reduce downstream pressure. both are reversible.
jamie.chen: +1. do we have a quick command to apply circuit-breaker? runbook references routing -> "traffic-circuits".
alex.rivera: running CLI now.
alex.rivera: ```
# temp policy: limit free tier and steer
redwoodctl routing apply --policy-name "cb-free-150-uswest2" \
  --match "tier=free" \
  --actions "route=us-west2-small;limit=150rps;fallback=standard-queue"
```
alex.rivera: applied. will validate.
jamie.chen: see immediate drop in error rate for free tier from 6% -> 1.1%. latency for standard still high though.
priya.nair: disabling reranking now (cheap win) — stopping async rerank worker group.
priya.nair: ```
kubectl scale deploy reranker --replicas=0 -n runtime
```
deploy-bot: reranker scaled to 0 replicas.
jamie.chen: nice - overall token processing time dropped ~22% on the hot path.
marc.levine: need comms: support triage note and status page blurb. Impact: degraded latencies for some paid customers, timeouts for some free/trial flows. ETA for normal: 30-45m with current mitigations.
alex.rivera: also enabled regional pin for 3 customers complaining: pinned them to dedicated-us-east1 lanes to avoid routing churn.
jamie.chen: recording mitigation steps in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1893456789 (runbook stub).
priya.nair: observing one runtime pool still reporting high GC pressure — digging into model size and batch sizes. might need to reduce max_batch to 4 on that pool.
alex.rivera: I'm lowering batch size on us-east1-gpu-pool.
alex.rivera: ```
redwoodctl pool update us-east1-gpu-pool --max-batch 4
```
jamie.chen: batch change accepted, some latency improvement ~8% tail.
marc.levine: how many customers impacted now? need exact numbers for exec update.
jamie.chen: quick estimate from query: ~120 accounts routed through smart-routing window; active degraded customers ~6, 2 showing timeouts. I'll run a precise query after this.
oncall-rotation: jamie, can you handoff to priya for next 2h? I'm about to go offline for meeting.
jamie.chen: handing to priya.nair. summary in thread: circuit-breaker applied for free tier -> 150rps + steer to us-west2-small; reranker disabled; batch size lowered on us-east1 pool; pinned 3 customers to dedicated lanes. Err rates down, tail latency improving. Priya, please monitor and escalate if regressions.
priya.nair: taking over. I'll keep routing in place and watch SLO dashboards. if error rate creeps above 2% for paid tier, we rollback reranker enable and consider capacity burst to dedicated pools.
marc.levine: support message drafted: "We are experiencing intermittent timeouts for some API requests; mitigation in progress. Paid customers prioritized. ETA ~30-45m." sending now.
jamie.chen: tagging ops for billing sensitivity: ensure circuit-breaker change doesn't inadvertently throttle paid plans.
alex.rivera: confirm: policy match was tier=free only. paid tiers untouched except pins.
priya.nair: monitoring logs and will post updates every 10m. current trend: overall 95p latency down 15% since mitigations, error rate near 1.2%.
incident-bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: mitigations applied. Incident status: under_mitigation. Next update in 10m. Report channel: #incidents.
priya.nair: leaving a note for postmortem/RCA: need better preemptive throttles in smart-router and alerting on KV cache miss ratio. assign to eng-runtime for followup.
jamie.chen: thanks team. I'm available on slack if needed, stepping off pager. :thumbsup:
priya.nair: acknowledged. continuing monitoring. will file followup ticket and attach perf traces.
